source_clause: EDPR8.) If the Delete Profile option is selected, a verification popup message will confirm the delete (previous to the memory seat selection confirmation).
leaf_desc_037: EDPR8.) If the Delete Profile option is selected, a verification popup message will confirm the delete (previous to the memory seat selection confirmation).
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.7（EDPR8）—— 選擇刪除後、實際刪除前須有確認 popup。關鍵情境條件：ER 明寫「尚未刪除」—— 若只驗 popup 出現而不驗資料仍在，一個「先刪再問」之實作也會通過（§7 false pass）。為什麼這樣切：刪除後之導覽屬 9.7.1、刪除後之 active profile 屬 9.7.2；本條為資料遺失風險之防線本身，故判 P0。

tcs.tc_title: Verification popup shown before a Profile is deleted
tcs.test_item:
Verification popup shown before a Profile is deleted

(Verifies that a confirmation popup appears after delete is chosen and before the Profile is removed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Two Driver Profiles exist and Profile A is active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “Edit Profile” tab and select “Delete Profile”
2. Read the screen and check that a verification popup is displayed before any deletion
tcs.expected_result:
1. “Delete Profile” is selected
2. A verification popup asking to confirm the delete is displayed and the Profile is not yet deleted
tcs.priority_basis: 刪除前之確認 —— **資料遺失風險之防線本身**
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
